test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a correct statement?

options.text: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.
Sikkim is the least populous state in India.
The state of Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014

solution:
The correct answer is __**Capital of Mizoram is Kohima**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Capital of Mizoram** is not Kohima; it is Aizawl. Kohima is the capital of Nagaland.
 
• **Rajasthan** is indeed the largest Indian state by area.
 
• Si
